$comment: The Continental Rift technical vertical slice (#203) — NOT CONTENT and NOT A CAMPAIGN THAT SHIPS: it lives outside content/, so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, no lobby can offer it, and its chapters (packages/shared/src/fixtures/continental-rift/) are short playable placeholders written to exercise the engine, not the story. It is the epic's (#191) end-to-end proof: one small map that uses every part of the graph runtime together. The Exchange's arrivals shelf has torn open into a single-use rift to the Glacier of Origins, a Starweaver can sense where it leads, and crossing it charges the party for the next fight; the glacier's cracking ice shelf is an environmental fight whose rescue befriends the yeti readers; going back down the Great River finds the Exchange changed (the source has woken and the harbour is flooded), the used-up rift refused and the long road north open instead; and the sealed rift into the glacier's heart opens for a Starweaver who has studied the stars on the Frostfang Peaks, for a Songkeeper who sings to it, or for any party the yeti readers owe. Two endings. packages/server/src/handlers/continental-rift.test.ts plays it across several evenings with and without a Starweaver; tools/content/continental-rift.test.ts holds it to the schemas, the chapter checks and the lint; docs/campaigns/graph-campaigns-authoring.md walks through it.
title: The Continental Rift (vertical slice)
blurb: A torn shelf at the Exchange, a glacier at the top of the world, and a river that remembers. A technical slice of the nonlinear campaign engine, not a story that ships.

attunement.$comment: The Starweaver's progression (#199), kept as journey state: sensing the shelf rift (+1) and studying the stars on the Frostfang Peaks (+1) earn the attunement the heart seal asks for (2); attuning it raises it to 3. Stored on the attempt row, so it is there on the next evening whoever comes.
attunement.label: Rift attunement

great-river.$comment: The world changing downstream (#198): whatever happens at the glacier, the source wakes, and the river that runs from it to the Exchange is in spate. The Exchange's flooded variant reads it.
great-river.label: The Great River

yeti-readers.$comment: The alliance the environmental fight earns (#201 into #198): freeing the trapped reader sets the chapter flag reader_freed, and the glacier's completion rule turns it into this fact. Friends open the heart seal for any party: the ungated way the lint (CLASS_GATED_ONLY_PATH) asks for beside the class ways.
yeti-readers.label: The yeti readers

rift-spark.$comment: Rift energy from crossing the shelf rift (#200): +1 on every hero's attack rolls in the next fight.
rift-spark.label: Rift Spark

marsh-mettle.$comment: The side trip's reward: the boggarts' marsh-mud steadies the party for the next fight.
marsh-mettle.label: Marsh Mettle

starlight-ward.$comment: The Starweaver's attunement leaves the party wrapped in starlight: Guard +1 in the next fight (the heart's).
starlight-ward.label: Starlight Ward

exchange.$comment: The entry, and the revisit that changes: once the river surges, coming back plays the flooded harbour (once - the completion rule remembers it was seen), and otherwise the Exchange is a hub the party walks through.
exchange.title: The Exchange

marsh.$comment: A side trip from the Exchange (sideways). Its completion grants a buff the next fight uses.
marsh.title: The Whispering Marsh

glacier.$comment: The environmental fight on the cracking ice shelf. Every completion wakes the river; freeing the yeti reader makes the readers friends. A pass hub once done.
glacier.title: The Glacier of Origins

peaks.$comment: A side trip from the glacier (sideways), played once (closed). Studying the stars from the summit is the campaign-earned half of the Starweaver's attunement; any party can play it, only a Starweaver can use it.
peaks.title: The Frostfang Peaks

shelf-rift.$comment: The single-use rift (#196): one crossing and it is consumed for good, drawn as used up from then on. Its destination is hidden until crossed - unless a Starweaver senses it first (#199, discover), which also raises the attunement. Crossing grants the Rift Spark (#200).
shelf-rift.label: Step into the tear above the arrivals shelf

discover.label: Sense where the tear leads
discover.hint: A Starweaver could feel where this tear goes.

exchange-north.$comment: The long road back to the glacier, once the party has been there: the way on after the shelf rift is used up.
exchange-north.label: The long road north

exchange-to-delta.label: Ride the flood out to the river mouth

meltwater-home.label: Ride the meltwater down the Great River

origin-seal.$comment: The sealed rift into the glacier's heart (#196, #197, #199). Asleep until someone has stood in the heart, so from here only an action opens it - and who can take each way differs: a Starweaver attuned enough (and the attuning wraps the party in starlight), a Songkeeper, or anyone the yeti readers owe.
origin-seal.label: The sealed blue door in the ice

open.label: Attune to the seal and open it
open.hint: A Starweaver who has studied the stars could open this.

open.label: Hum the ice's own note until the seal parts
Ask the yeti readers to open the seal
